# NivoratClient Comprehensive Function-Level Protection Map

This map provides a granular method-by-method audit of the entire NivoratClient codebase.
Protection is enforced at the function, expression, constant, and branch levels.

### Tier Summary
- **FUNCTION_CRITICAL**: 83 methods (Proprietary combat, ballistics, neural, aim, timing, prediction)
- **FUNCTION_HIGH**: 299 methods (Heuristics, slot arbitration, reach guards, threshold ladders)
- **FUNCTION_HOT**: 1586 methods (Per-frame render geometry, MSDF shaders, tick loops - 0 FPS regression)
- **FUNCTION_BOUNDARY**: 110 methods (Fabric entrypoints, Mixin callbacks, external ABI contracts)
- **FUNCTION_MEDIUM**: 4427 methods (Internal utility arithmetic and data helpers)
- **Total Audited Methods**: 6505

---
